# v26.0 WP10: Territory rework triggers migrated to BYZ/ROM (oe_is_phoenix_empire), R04/R06/R11 safe,
# and widened oe_tm_prov_target to 3 clean provincialisation paths (Roman group OR overlord faith OR accepted+80op+35auth).
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope (a subject of BYZ/ROM).
oe_tm_integration_ok = {
    custom_tooltip = {
        text = oe_tm_tt_opinion_int
        OR = {
            AND = { country_exists = c:ROM is_subject_of = c:ROM opinion = { target = c:ROM value >= 50 } }
            AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ is_subject_of = c:BYZ opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } }
        }
    }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tm_tt_ladder oe_tm_ladder_days_ok = yes }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tm_tt_demoted NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_demote_cd } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_ttb_tt_ally_cd NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ally_cd } }
}

# Country scope. Extra years from refused musters on top of the base 10-year dependency.
oe_tm_ladder_days_ok = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 15 }
        OR = {
            AND = { country_exists = c:ROM dependency_length_days = { target = c:ROM value > 9125 } }
            AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ dependency_length_days = { target = c:BYZ value > 9125 } }
        }
    }
    trigger_else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 10 }
        OR = {
            AND = { country_exists = c:ROM dependency_length_days = { target = c:ROM value > 7300 } }
            AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ dependency_length_days = { target = c:BYZ value > 7300 } }
        }
    }
    trigger_else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 5 }
        OR = {
            AND = { country_exists = c:ROM dependency_length_days = { target = c:ROM value > 5475 } }
            AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ dependency_length_days = { target = c:BYZ value > 5475 } }
        }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

# Country scope. Months as a provincialised subject, 120 plus 12 per year of muster delay.
oe_tm_prov_months_ok = {
    trigger_if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 15 } has_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months var:oe_tm_sub2_months >= 300 }
    trigger_else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 10 } has_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months var:oe_tm_sub2_months >= 240 }
    trigger_else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 5 } has_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months var:oe_tm_sub2_months >= 180 }
    trigger_else = { has_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months var:oe_tm_sub2_months >= 120 }
}

# Country scope. A subject that may be provincialised now (设省) via 3 lawful paths.
oe_tm_prov_target = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:ROM is_subject_of = c:ROM }
        AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ is_subject_of = c:BYZ }
    }
    country_type = location
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_prov_cd }
    any_owned_location = { count >= 1 }
    OR = {
        is_subject_type = oe_sub_mam
        AND = {
            is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II
            oe_tm_prov_months_ok = yes
            OR = {
                AND = { country_exists = c:ROM is_subject_of = c:ROM opinion = { target = c:ROM value >= 70 } }
                AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ is_subject_of = c:BYZ opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 70 } }
                ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_rome_province_elect_support_mod }
            }
            OR = {
                # Path 1: Primary culture belongs to the Roman/Greek culture group (including all 20 derived Roman cultures).
                culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
                # Path 2: Shares the state religion of the Phoenix Empire (Orthodox or restored Hellenic/Polytheist).
                AND = { country_exists = c:ROM is_subject_of = c:ROM religion ?= c:ROM.religion }
                AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ is_subject_of = c:BYZ religion ?= c:BYZ.religion }
                # Path 3: Federative charter path — accepted culture + 80 opinion + 35 Imperial Authority.
                AND = {
                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            country_exists = c:ROM
                            is_subject_of = c:ROM
                            culture ?= { is_accepted_in = c:ROM }
                            opinion = { target = c:ROM value >= 80 }
                        }
                        AND = {
                            country_exists = c:BYZ
                            is_subject_of = c:BYZ
                            culture ?= { is_accepted_in = c:BYZ }
                            opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 80 }
                        }
                    }
                    exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                        has_variable = oe_pillars_authority
                        var:oe_pillars_authority >= 35
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ/ROM scope. The 设省 action may be used.
oe_tm_prov_allowed = {
    oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
    exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
    is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tm_tt_auth has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10 }
    }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tm_tt_pending NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_pending } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tm_tt_any_target any_subject = { oe_tm_prov_target = yes } }
}

# Country scope. A provincialised subject whose opinion of BYZ/ROM stayed below 0 for 36 months in a row.
oe_tm_demote_due = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:ROM is_subject_of = c:ROM }
        AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ is_subject_of = c:BYZ }
    }
    is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II
    has_variable = oe_tm_neg_months
    var:oe_tm_neg_months >= 36
}

# Country scope. Answers the alliance muster at a campaign start.
oe_tm_muster_member = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:ROM is_subject_of = c:ROM NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:ROM } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ is_subject_of = c:BYZ NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
    }
    OR = {
        is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub
        is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II
        is_subject_type = oe_roman_march
        is_subject_type = oe_arabian_kingdom
        is_subject_type = oe_black_sea_kingdom
        is_subject_type = oe_persian_empire
        is_subject_type = oe_hungarian_dominion
        is_subject_type = oe_german_kingdom
        is_subject_type = oe_german_holy_empire
    }
    exists = capital
}
